title: The termwise product of two etale hypercovers is a hypercover
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $U_\bullet\to X$ and $V_\bullet\to X$ be augmented simplicial objects in the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] whose degree-$n$ maps to their matching objects are etale coverings for every $n\geq0$. The augmented simplicial object with degree-$n$ term $U_n\times_XV_n$ and structure maps induced by those of $U$ and $V$ is an etale hypercover of $X$. Its two projections are morphisms of hypercovers to $U$ and $V$.
